name: Grow (Meshulam) Payment Connector
description: Grow (Meshulam) Light API integration for BASE44: CreatePaymentLink, verified webhook settlement, approveTransaction, and status reconciliation.
instructions: 1. Set GROW_USER_ID, GROW_PAGE_CODE and GROW_API_KEY (all three required). 2. Deploy create-grow-payment, grow-webhook and check-grow-status. 3. Register the grow-webhook URL with GROW as the notifyUrl. 4. Keep GROW_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox until GROW moves the account to SECURE, then set GROW_EXPECTED_TERMINAL before switching to production.

env.description: Merchant user id from the Grow dashboard
Page code for the payment layout
Sent as the x-api-key header. Mandatory since Grow's 2026-08 server update; requests without it are rejected.
"production" switches to the live hosts. Anything else stays on sandbox.
Terminal code issued for this merchant. Required in production: a test terminal reports every charge as successful while collecting nothing.
1 = regular VAT, 3 = VAT-exempt. Required field on CreatePaymentLink.
Absolute URL Grow posts the callback to. Defaults to <function origin>/grow-webhook.
Fallback redirect after payment when the caller does not pass successUrl.
Shared secret echoed as webhookKey on the invoice/recurring callback formats. Not sent on PaymentLink callbacks — those are verified by sender IP.
Override for Grow's published webhook sender IPs (comma or space separated).
"1" disables webhook sender verification. Local testing only — it makes the endpoint forgeable by anyone.
Overrides the Light API host if Grow issues this merchant a different one.
Origin allowed to call create-grow-payment. Leave unset only in development.

endpoints.notes: Prices the order server-side from the Order entity. The client cannot set the amount.

orderId.description: Order entity id. The amount is read from it.

processId.description: Grow process id, stored for reconciliation

endpoints.notes: Register this URL with Grow as notifyUrl. Verifies the sender IP, matches on cField1, checks the amount, settles once, then calls approveTransaction. Always answers 200.
Reconciliation path for a callback that never arrived. Confirms with Grow server-to-server and may settle the order.

order_entity_fields.payment_idempotency_key: string — generated per attempt, sent as cField1, used to match the callback
order_entity_fields.payment_amount_agorot: number — integer agorot, the amount the webhook is checked against
order_entity_fields.payment_id: string — Grow process id, then the transaction reference once settled
order_entity_fields.payment_process_token: string — Grow process token, for getPaymentProcessInfo
order_entity_fields.payment_url: string — the hosted payment page URL
